pair_witness_rule: For every feasible adjacent ordered pair, choose the shortest then lexicographically first legal trace of length <=4 containing it; exclude traces containing contiguous OBS,REV,ACT; deduplicate and sort selected traces.
legality: All event deliveries are attempts except REL, which exists only as the owner release of a currently active admitted hold.

transitions.ACT: Commit iff lease_open and evidence_fresh and not held; otherwise deny.
transitions.REV: Set lease_open=false; if held, clear held and increment verified_releases.
transitions.REL: Feasible iff held; clear held and increment verified_releases.
transitions.STALE: Set evidence_fresh=false; if held, clear held and increment verified_releases.

mutants.pair_stale_lease: ACT immediately following REV ignores the revoked lease if evidence is fresh.
mutants.triple_stale_permit: ACT following exact suffix OBS,REV ignores the revoked lease if evidence is fresh.
